module: Decides which UI route (ui_router) to display when the player opens, closes or toggles the menu: main menu, pause menu v2, garage, mission or scenario screens, or return to the game. It emits the hooks onBeforeMenuOpened and onMenuToggled. A modder uses it to open/close the menu by script or to set the active game route (setGameplayRoute) or pause route (setPauseRoute).
notes: Most functions return a table {handled = true, targetRoute, navigation} or {handled = false, reason = "no_current_route"} when no route is active.
Without a loaded level (getMissionFilename empty), the only valid "menu" destination is "menu" (main menu); pause and play are level routes.
Default game route: "play". Pause routes: "pause" (pause v2, or "pause.replay:pause-replay-player" if a replay is loaded), or "menu.careerPause" in career if pause v2 is disabled.
pauseV2Enabled is a local variable set to true; no function modifies it, so isPauseV2Enabled always returns true.
When a back navigation is blocked by a route guard (guard_blocked_exit), the exit is only forced to the menu on the 6th consecutive block (BLOCK_FORCE_THRESHOLD).
In garage mode, toggleMenu opens "garage" from "menu", does nothing if already on "garage", otherwise goes back.
During a scenario in the pre-running state, toggleMenu opens "scenario.start"; in the finished/post state, the end screen (scenario.end, scenario.quickrace.end or scenario.chapter.end).
Route aliases exist for MenuOpenModule: vehicleselect -> menu.vehicles, vehicleconfig -> menu.vehicleconfig.parts, vehicledebug -> menu.vehicleconfig.debug, appedit -> pause.hudApps.

toggleMenu.desc: Toggles between the game and the menu (Escape key). Handles the cases of no level, garage, mission screens (mission.control), scenarios, game to menu, menu to game, otherwise navigates back.

returns.desc: {handled = boolean, ...} with targetRoute and navigation depending on the case.

openMenu.desc: Opens the menu (pause route or main menu) unless already there. Emits onBeforeMenuOpened then onMenuToggled(true).

closeToMenu.desc: Navigates directly to the "menu" route (main menu), without emitting onMenuToggled.

closeMenu.desc: Returns to the active game route (emits onMenuToggled(false)), unless already on a game route or on "garage" or there is no current route.

MenuOpenModule.desc: Navigates to a route: either a string (route name, alias, or "options" which becomes "pause.options" in a level), or a table {state, params}. Returns nothing.

data.desc: Route name or {state = route, params = table}.

menuHide.desc: Displays the menu (menu/pause route) if showMenu is true, otherwise the game route.

setGameplayRoute.desc: Sets the route considered as "game" ("play" if nil).

setPauseRoute.desc: Sets a specific pause route, taking priority over "pause" when a level is loaded (nil to return to the default behavior).

isPauseV2Enabled.desc: Returns whether pause menu v2 is active (always true in this version, see notes).
